note: Owner card 2026-11-13: 9 frames + typeset spec card, hero first and checked against the reference. Hero v1 held (nine square stones, about a quarter of the circle, flat end walls). the symmetric count (fifth stone in the middle, four on each side) still gave 8 stones; the pose was changed instead of tightening the sentence a third time
